Welcome to Nōvuu

Renewal is our core.

At Nōvuu (pronounced NOH-voo), renewal is more than a concept, it's our core. Inspired by the word "new" and the idea of transformation, the name Nōvuu reflects our mission: to help you reconnect with the most vibrant, confident version of yourself.

The double "u" in our name symbolizes your complete self, inside and out, revitalized and in harmony.

Our services

What we offer

Weight Loss Management

Reach your healthiest weight with a personalized, medically supervised program — combining proven injectable therapies with expert guidance to create results that last.

Learn more

Injectables

Precisely placed to complement your natural features, our injectable treatments restore volume, soften lines, and refine your look — with results that feel effortlessly you.

Learn more

Microneedling

Unlock your skin's own renewal response. Micro-precise channels stimulate collagen and elastin production — visibly improving texture, softening scars, and restoring a healthy, radiant glow.

Learn more

Chemical Peels

Medical-grade exfoliation that goes beyond the surface. Targets fine lines, acne, sun damage, and uneven tone to reveal the clearer, more luminous skin beneath — with minimal downtime.

Learn more

PRF Hair Restoration

Your body's own growth factors, activated. This regenerative treatment uses your blood's natural healing proteins to revitalize follicles and support thicker, healthier hair growth from within.

Learn more

IV Infusions

Skip the wait. Essential fluids and nutrients delivered directly to your bloodstream for immediate, full-absorption results — restoring energy, immunity, and clarity in a single session.

Learn more

Wellness Injections

Small dose, serious impact. Targeted shots of B12, vitamin C, and lipotropic blends designed to lift energy, support immunity, and keep you performing at your best between visits.

Learn more
